name: How does engineer coordination impact project timelines and costs?
description: Effective engineer coordination reduces project timelines and costs by minimizing change orders and preventing construction delays.

mainEntity.name: How does engineer coordination impact project timelines and costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective engineer coordination can significantly reduce project timelines and costs. By identifying and resolving discrepancies in designs early, it minimizes change orders, avoids construction delays, and prevents expensive rework. Poor coordination, however, often leads to unexpected problems during construction, requiring costly modifications and extending project schedules. Investing in thorough coordination upfront saves resources in the long run.
